title: SW Washington Salmon Rivers
identified: 2026-10-18, named by Daniel when asking for improvements
what: Full-bleed river map of six southwest Washington salmon fisheries (Cowlitz, Lower Columbia, Lewis, Wind, Klickitat, Drano Lake) with a species picker built from the app's exact species names (Coho Salmon, Chinook Salmon, Fall Chinook) and a detail sheet. Fall Chinook has one report (Lewis River); other rivers show gray No report. Each sheet also shows the newest WDFW weekly creel counts (counts, not ratings). Catch-report ratings, not season dates.
note: Source is index.html plus geo.js and reports.js in this folder; baseline.html is the pre-split single-file page and the rollback source. Refresh by PASSING THIS URL and files={geo.js, reports.js, counts.js}.
